reviewed_by: Claude: DeepSeek V4 empty turns, focused provider/markup/recovery-receipt selection
reason: DeepSeek V4 on OpenRouter sometimes writes its DSML tool call into the reasoning channel with no tool_calls and no answer; Core recovered markup from answer text only, so the reply read as reasoning-only and fed final-answer recovery until a goal blocked. ModelResponse now recovers complete DSML / DeepSeek special-token frames from reasoning when an adapter reply has no answer and no call (GLM/Qwen tags stay thoughts; stripped fragments are marked unreadable, never run). Chat Completions replies carry a bounded redacted stream trace recorded in the final-answer receipt and in new providers.stream.empty_reply / failed_trace diagnostics; chat.routing.empty_tool_batch and hook-stop diagnostics now use allowlisted metadata keys; the diagnostics allowlist gains finish_reasons, stream_choices, stream_frames. Select the new synthetic-SSE regression file, the markup recovery suites (dsml, native tool markup, provider leftovers) for the refactored tool_markup.recover, the OpenAI-compatible robustness and reasoning replay suites for the stream adapter and replay fields, the hook-stop and chat tool-loop suites plus the two test_chat.py receipt tests whose expected receipt gained fields, and test_diagnostics.py for the allowlist change.
exclusions: No UI, setting or native change: frontend, Playwright and native layers are empty and the settings assistant is unchanged. Other test_chat.py cases do not assert the final-answer receipt shape. No full-suite approval.
